Notas de versión

Qué cambió en cada versión de Sunmeld. Sunmeld sigue en desarrollo, así que por ahora no hay notas.

Beta 1.0.0 (22) · 2026-11-12

Beta 1.0.0 (16) · 2026-11-07 06:25 KST

Test build: landscape, full unlock, family sharing, 4 tip sizes

Esta nota solo está disponible en inglés.

A test build for the iOS beta. The game is still in development.

  • The game now has a landscape layout.
  • The full unlock is a one-time $1.99 purchase.
  • The full unlock can be shared with your family through Family Sharing.
  • Settings now has an optional supporter tip in 4 sizes ($0.99 / $2.99 / $5.99 / $9.99). It gives no in-game benefit.

  • Settings: the value on the Nickname row now sits at the right edge, and every arrow lines up.
